title: Balaclava Gang: Action
heading: The Bank Robbery music video: the balaclava gang
moodboard_intro: ROUND 10, for Kai (11 Nov): "a bit more of the balaclava guys rapping at the camera … like a modern London drill group of five or six guys, all gesticulating towards the camera". 20 shots (h01–h20), two takes each, every one in a place already in the film: the bank lobby, the salt flats, the jetty, the train, the elevated railway, the girders, the observation deck, the vault door, the teller hall, the roadhouse raid, the frozen river, the balloon field, the airfield, the radio booth, the dining car, the press hall, the bank steps, the boulevard, the marquee street, the rooftop. Vote This on the ones to animate. Nothing is spent on video until you pick.

beats.name: Intro
beats.blurb: The gang walks in; the doors burst; the getaway skids.

beats.name: Verse 1
beats.blurb: Money from a tree, make hay, where does it go, grandma freezing, stimulus checks.

beats.name: Verse 2
beats.blurb: Rent seeking, the meeting, the Fed, the printer, fiat debt.

beats.name: Chorus
beats.blurb: Robbery! Call the police! Debasement in the basement, the printer burning.

beats.name: Verse 3
beats.blurb: Elastic cash, the flash, the angry mob, blame, dilution, distraction, the hand.

beats.name: Verse 4
beats.blurb: The devil's radio station, vaults like a wheelbarrow, the narrow ledge, your own supply.

beats.name: Verse 5
beats.blurb: The scam, bail out, winter, inflation, print more, revolution, give, cake.

beats.name: Action
beats.blurb: Hot rods, Tommy guns, chases, rum-runners, raids: Jack's 'more cool action'.

beats.name: Sarcastic stage-rap gestures
beats.blurb: Big stage-rapper moves (chop, shrug, counting off, hand on heart, the spin), caught at the peak and done sarcastically, each on its line.

beats.name: Rapping to camera
beats.blurb: Round 6: the gang raps straight into the lens in sixteen Prohibition places, each on its own lyric line, with big early-2000s stage moves.

beats.name: Fixes from your cut-6 notes
beats.blurb: New versions of the shots you rejected: the getaway driver, two in the car, the plane, the door, the barrels, the safe, MARINE in the alley.

beats.name: The whole gang at the lens
beats.blurb: Round 10 (Kai, 11 Nov): all six performing at the camera like a modern drill crew, each in a place already in the film, adjusted a little. Pick the ones to animate; they become 6-second clips to cut in.
